sources.snippet: convert_from_hf_checkpoint.py: loads the base model, prunes it to 50% unstructured sparsity across attention and MLP, and writes a self-contained compressed checkpoint (base config, tokenizer, and packed sparse weights). dequantize_to_bf16.py: loads that checkpoint and reconstructs a standard dense bf16 HF model directory.
